title: Testing the Blog System
excerpt: This is just a test post to see if everything’s working. Spoiler: it is. 😎
content:
Today I tested my new blog system — built entirely with flat JSON files hosted on GitHub Pages, and rendered with custom PHP on my site.

It's clean, lightweight, and 100% mine.

Here's to publishing without pushing code every time. 💻✨

Next step? Maybe a GitHub API connection so I can hit 'Publish' right from my site. Let's get it.

✌🏻 - Ryan

title: Why I’m Using JSON for My Blog
excerpt: I wanted something simple, lightweight, and developer-friendly. So I built my blog with flat JSON files and PHP.
content:
Most people reach for WordPress or a static site generator when they want to start blogging. But I wanted to keep things minimal — and also fun.

So I decided to use GitHub Pages to store my blog posts as raw JSON files. Then, my PHP site fetches those files and renders them on the fly. No pushing code for each post. No admin dashboard. Just me, my editor, and Git.

This approach keeps my content portable, version-controlled, and easy to evolve. Plus, it makes for a cool blog post in itself. 😎

If you’re into clean architecture, indie web building, or just hate WordPress bloat — you might dig this too.

More to come.

🧙‍♂️ - Ryan
